title: DevOps and Cloud Engineer
tagline: Automate builds, ship containers and run infrastructure as code
description: Learn how software gets delivered and operated. Start with Linux and the shell, master Git and CI with GitHub Actions, containerise with Docker, orchestrate with Kubernetes, describe infrastructure with Terraform and deploy to a major cloud.
audience: Developers and sysadmins moving into DevOps, platform or cloud roles

stages.title: Linux
stages.description: The terminal, files, permissions, processes and networking.

stages.title: Bash scripting
stages.description: Automate repetitive tasks with scripts, pipes and cron.

stages.title: Git and GitHub
stages.description: Branching strategies, reviews and release management.

stages.title: CI/CD with GitHub Actions
stages.description: Workflows, runners, secrets and deployment pipelines.

stages.title: Kubernetes
stages.description: Pods, deployments, services, ingress and configuration.

stages.title: Terraform
stages.description: Infrastructure as code with providers, state and modules.

stages.title: A cloud platform
stages.description: Core services, identity, networking and deployment on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.

seo.title: DevOps and Cloud Engineer Learning Path
seo.description: Roadmap through Linux, Bash, Git, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform and AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.
